versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to coldsteel
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - ' -k msupdate'
        - ' -k msupdate2'
        - ' -k alg'
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'UpdateDriverForPlugAndPlayDevicesW'
        - 'ServiceMain'
        - 'DiUninstallDevice'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe" ParentCommandLine IN ("* -k msupdate*", "* -k msupdate2*", "* -k alg*") Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine IN ("*UpdateDriverForPlugAndPlayDevicesW*", "*ServiceMain*", "*DiUninstallDevice*")
